description: Claim a refresh task and return its full brief — subject body, plain-language reason, raw detection signals and AI instructions. Calling this transitions the task to status='in_progress' so other AI sessions don't double-claim it. After you apply the fix via `pathrule_update_memory`/`pathrule_update_rule` (pass `refresh_id` to auto-resolve) OR decide not to, call `pathrule_resolve_refresh`.

claimed_by.description: Optional — identify the AI client (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'codex'). Written to the audit trail.

name: pathrule_get_refresh_brief
title: Get memory/rule refresh brief
